description: This file is a test suite for PyTorch optimizers and related functionalities, including serialization, device compatibility, parameter updates, complex parameters, sparse gradients, memory usage, and API correctness. It contains various tests class, helper functions, and parameterized test cases aimed at validating optimizer behavior across different configurations and hardware backends.

classes.name: TestOptimRenewed
classes.description: A comprehensive test class for PyTorch optimizer algorithms, testing correctness, serialization, device compatibility, parameter updates, complex and sparse tensor handling, memory profiling, and API conformance.

methods.name: test_optim_infos_do_not_specify_global_cliquey_kwargs( self, device, dtype, optim_info )
methods.description: Verifies that optimizer inputs do not specify global flags for foreach, fused, or differentiable implementations when not intended.

methods.name: test_errors(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Ensures proper error handling and warnings for invalid optimizer construction or step calls with erroneous inputs.

methods.name: test_forloop_goes_right_direction( self, device, dtype, optim_info, contiguous, with_lrsched )
methods.description: Validates that the for-loop implementation of each optimizer decreases or increases the loss correctly over iterations.

methods.name: test_forloop_goes_right_direction_multigpu( self, device, dtype, optim_info, with_lrsched )
methods.description: Same as above but for multi-GPU setup, ensuring consistency across devices.

methods.name: test_param_group_with_lrscheduler_goes_right_direction( self, device, dtype, optim_info )
methods.description: Tests that parameter groups with different learning rates behave as expected when coupled with LR schedulers.

methods.name: test_tensor_lr
methods.description: Checks support for learning rates specified as tensors of various dimensions.

methods.name: test_rosenbrock_sparse(self, device, dtype, optim_info, with_lrsched)
methods.description: Tests optimizer behavior with sparse gradients on the Rosenbrock function, including sparse and dense parameter updates.

methods.name: test_complex(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Validates optimizer correctness with complex-valued parameters, ensuring views and steps are consistent between real and complex parametrizations.

methods.name: test_complex_2d(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Tests complex parameter handling where real and imaginary parts are separated, ensuring correctness of non-closure loops.

methods.name: test_adamw_serialization(self, device)
methods.description: Verifies that AdamW optimizer’s state_dict correctly preserves decoupled weight decay settings and that loading state_dicts is deterministic.

methods.name: _compare_between( self, inputs, models, optimizers, assert_eq_kwargs=None, assert_step_dtype=None )
methods.description: Helper function to compare optimizer behaviors under different configurations, especially 'fused' and 'foreach'.

methods.name: test_foreach_matches_forloop(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Checks that foreach optimizer implementations produce results similar to the for-loop version.

methods.name: test_mixed_device_dtype(self, device, dtype, optim_info, impl)
methods.description: Ensures optimizer consistency when parameters are on different devices and have different dtypes, especially with mixed backends like CUDA and CPU.

methods.name: test_set_default_dtype_works_with_foreach(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Confirms that setting the default dtype affects foreach implementations as expected, especially in reduction settings.

methods.name: test_foreach_large_tensor(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Tests performance and correctness with very large tensors, simulating up to 72GB memory usage.

methods.name: test_peak_memory_foreach(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Profiles peak memory usage of foreach optimizers to ensure they stay within expected bounds.

methods.name: test_fused_matches_forloop(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Verifies that fused optimizer implementations produce results consistent with the non-fused versions.

methods.name: test_fused_error_on_params_on_meta(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Checks for proper error handling when attempting to optimize parameters on meta device with fused optimizers.

methods.name: test_fused_large_tensor(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Ensures correctness when optimizing very large tensors with fused optimizers, on devices supporting large memory (e.g., 64+ GB).

methods.name: test_fused_does_not_step_if_foundinf(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Verifies that fused optimizers correctly skip updates if an infinity gradient is detected.

methods.name: test_cpu_load_state_dict(self, device, dtype, impl, optim_info)
methods.description: Simulates loading state dicts on CPU from fused/capturable optimizers created on GPU, ensuring correctness.

methods.name: test_param_groups_weight_decay(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Checks that different parameter groups with individual weight decay settings behave as expected after training.

methods.name: test_param_groups_lr(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Validates that parameter groups with different learning rates are updated correctly.

methods.name: test_step_is_noop_when_params_have_no_grad
methods.description: Confirms that calling step with parameters that have no grad does not cause errors or unintended updates.

methods.name: test_step_is_noop_for_zero_grads
methods.description: Verifies that optimizer step does not change parameters if all grads are zeros.

methods.name: test_grads_are_never_inplaced_into(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Checks that optimizer steps do not modify stored gradient variables in-place, preserving gradient versioning.

methods.name: test_optimizer_can_be_printed(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Ensures that optimizer's __repr__() method works without errors.

methods.name: test_state_dict_deterministic( self, device, dtype, optim_info, is_named_optim0, is_named_optim1 )
methods.description: Checks that optimizer state dictionaries are deterministic and consistent across saves and loads.

methods.name: test_can_load_older_state_dict(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Verifies that optimizers can load older state dicts with missing flags or updated structures without errors.

methods.name: test_can_load_from_to_named_state_dict( self, device, dtype, optim_info, is_named_optim0, is_named_optim1 )
methods.description: Validates that optimizers can load from state dicts with different parameter naming schemes, preserving parameter references.

methods.name: test_save_load_equality_with_weights_only( self, device, dtype, optim_info, is_named_optim )
methods.description: Tests that saving and loading only weights produce consistent state dicts, including sparse and dense parameters.

methods.name: test_load_nontensor_step(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Ensures optimizer load_state_dict works with non-tensor entries for step, including cases with sparse gradients.

methods.name: test_state_dict_with_cuda_params
methods.description: Validates loading and saving state dicts when parameters are on CUDA, including device device consistency and step device preservation.

methods.name: None _state_dict_pre_hook(optimizer: Optimizer)
methods.description: A static method registering a pre-hook that adds a 'test' key to the optimizer's state dictionary.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _state_dict_post_hook( optimizer: Optimizer, state_dict: dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: A static method registering a post-hook that removes the 'test' key and adds an indicator to the state dict.

methods.name: test_state_dict_pre_hook
methods.description: Tests registering a pre-hook for state dict saving and ensures the hook's effects are reflected.

methods.name: test_state_dict_post_hook
methods.description: Tests registering a post-hook for state dict saving and ensures the hook's effects are reflected.

methods.name: test_state_dict_pre_post_hook
methods.description: Verifies that both pre- and post-hooks can be registered and their effects appear in the saved state dict.

methods.name: None _load_state_dict_pre_hook1( optimizer: Optimizer, state_dict: dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: A static method to modify a state dict's learning rate during loading, simulating custom preprocessing.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _load_state_dict_pre_hook2( optimizer: Optimizer, state_dict: dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: A static method to copy and modify a state dict's learning rate during loading, showcasing custom preprocessing with copying.

methods.name: None _load_state_dict_post_hook(optimizer: Optimizer)
methods.description: A static method to set a flag indicating the load hook was run.

methods.name: test_load_state_dict_pre_hook_and_prepend(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Tests the registration of load_state_dict pre-hooks with and without prepend, verifying custom modifications are applied correctly.

methods.name: test_load_state_dict_post_hook(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Tests registration of post-hooks during load and verifies custom hooks are executed.

methods.name: test_load_state_dict_pre_post_hook(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Ensures both pre- and post-hooks can be registered together and their effects are visible after load.

methods.name: test_step_post_hook
methods.description: Checks that step post-hook callbacks are invoked and modify internal data during optimizer steps.

methods.name: test_step_pre_hook
methods.description: Checks that step pre-hook callbacks are invoked and modify internal data during optimizer steps.

methods.name: test_step_all_hooks
methods.description: Verifies that global and local step hooks are called in the correct order and can be deregistered properly.

methods.name: test_deepcopy_copies_all_public_attrs(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Verifies that copying an optimizer via deepcopy reproduces all public attributes.

methods.name: test_second_order_optims_return_consistent_types( self, device, dtype, optim_info )
methods.description: Tests that second-order optimizers return results of consistent types across different tolerance settings.

methods.name: test_fused_cpu_matches_cuda(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Validates that fused optimizers produce same results on CPU and CUDA when supported.

methods.name: test_defaults_changed_to_foreach(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Ensures that default optimizer implementations switch to foreach variants where supported.

methods.name: test_non_empty_state(self, device, dtype, optim_info)
methods.description: Checks that the internal state of optimizers is not empty after optimization steps.

methods.name: test_step_iteration
methods.description: Verifies that optimizer step function performs the expected number of gradient updates in a sequence.
